'''Paolo''' is an NPC who appears in [[Montelli Quarter]], [[Ragunna]] at daytime. He sells Thief's Talon, which he claims can bring fortune to its owner. (You can buy it after interacting with him for 3000 [[Shell Credit|Shell Credits]]).

After you buy his Thief's Talon, wait for 2 days, and then you can find him talking to talking to [[Alberto]] in [[City Square]] behind a bush. After you interact with him, you will get 30000 Shell Credits and an achievement, [[Justice Is Done]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
:'''Paolo:''' Excuse me, {{MC|m=Sir|f=Miss}}! I can tell you're a distinguished guest of Ragunna!
:'''Paolo:''' You're exactly the kind of person destined to make a mark in the vibrant [[Montelli Quarter]].
:'''Paolo:''' Alas, it's such a shame...
:{{DIcon}} A shame?
:'''Paolo:''' Many people want to connect with the Montelli family here, but few manage to strike it rich.
:'''Paolo:''' Ultimately, they lack something essential, just like you. What a shame...
:{{DIcon}} What special item do I need to do business here?
:'''Paolo:''' You need the golden touch—an amulet that brings fortune, the Thief's Talon.
:'''Paolo:''' Carry one of these, and soon enough, everyone will know your name in the Montelli Quarter.
:'''Paolo:''' As luck would have it, I have one for sale. I'll let it go for three thousand. It's a treasured heirloom of mine...
:{{DIcon}} Three thousand!?
:'''Paolo:''' A fair price, I assure you!
:'''Paolo:''' Wait! Don't go, {{MC|m=Sir|f=Miss}}! I have other items too! If that's too much, I can give you a discount. Please, just take a look...
----
;(Buying Thief's Talon)
:'''Paolo:''' As we say in Ragunna, those who have a keen eye always find wealth.
:'''Paolo:''' Have a wonderful day, lucky {{MC|m=gentleman|f=lady}}. May fortune be with you.
----
;(After buying Thief's Talon)
:'''Alberto:''' Oh, look, isn't it my old friend Paolo!
:'''Paolo:''' Acolyte Germano from the Order Tribunal? What a coincidence!
:'''Alberto:''' I've been watching your little transaction with this {{MC|m=gentleman|f=lady}}.
:'''Alberto:''' So, what did you sell this time? Shh... don't say anything yet. Let me guess.
:'''Paolo:''' Hehe, I was just...
:'''Alberto:''' Shh—don't interrupt my thinking!
:'''Alberto:''' Was it... the cure-all Mastic Nuvola?
:'''Alberto:''' No way, this {{MC|m=gentleman|f=lady}} looks fit enough to take me down easily.
:'''Alberto:''' Was it... the Sunflare Nectar that makes people glow?
:'''Alberto:''' Well... {{MC|m=he|f=she}} is already so handsome. I bet all the artists in Ragunna would jump at the chance to paint {{MC|m=him|f=her}}.
:'''Alberto:''' Oh my! I'm so forgetful! It was the Thief's Talon, am I right?
:{{DIcon}} Do I look poor to you?
:'''Alberto:''' That's not what I meant. Rich or poor, one can never have too many Shell Credits.
:'''Alberto:''' So, are you planning to pay your customer back tenfold, or are you coming with me, Paolo?
:{{DIcon}} You owe me 30,000 Shell Credits!
:'''Alberto:''' Paolo, looks like your Thief's Talon finally worked for once.
:{{DIcon}} It really worked!
:'''Paolo:''' Wh-what? Damn my luck!
{{Dialogue End}}
